material_findings.title: Low-regularity source dependence is only a sufficient specialization
material_findings.details: BIT (6.3) and (6.5) use a governing exponent theta0; Theorem 6.1 explicitly permits theta0=0 when theta<1/2. With theta=s in Theorem 6.3, this supplies Hdot^0-based uniformity for every 0<s<1/2. Submitted BITDependence67Norm instead bounds the sum of Hdot^s flow norms and chooses constants after that higher bound. At s=1/2 the source allows theta0>0 whereas the submitted type fixes theta0=s. No checked equivalence restores the missing dependence. The norm/a.e. equivalence preserves the specialized hypotheses unchanged.
